# PAAS-005: Projects do not share the platform default network

- **Group:** Coolify and Dokploy
- **Severity when it fails:** moderate
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

Coolify attaches apps to its "coolify" destination network and Dokploy to "dokploy-network" unless a project gets its own. On a shared network every app resolves and reaches every other project's services by name, including databases, so one compromised app can talk to the rest. DKR-030 judges every network; this check names the platform setting behind it.

## Verify by hand

```sh
docker network inspect coolify --format '{{range .Containers}}{{.Name}} {{end}}'
```

## How to fix it

Give each project its own destination (Coolify: a new destination network per project; Dokploy: an isolated network per compose project) and attach the platform proxy to each.

## What a fix can break

Apps that call another project's service by its container name stop resolving it; route those calls through the proxy or join only the two that need it.

Run `stackward explain PAAS-005` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
